test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want to be stopped when I try to sell an accessory below the store's floor price or above its list price, so that I cannot give away margin or overcharge a customer by mistyping
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
Letting a rep set their own price at the counter is only safe if there is a fence around it. The business sets a floor per accessory - the least the store is prepared to sell it for - and the ceiling is the item's ordinary list price, because this is a discount and a rep must never be able to charge a customer more than the shelf price. There is deliberately no manager override in this version: a price outside the range is simply refused, for everyone, with a message that names the limit that was breached so the rep knows what they are allowed to do. This matters in both directions. Below the floor the store loses margin on every sale, and a mistyped figure - a missing decimal point - could hand an accessory over for almost nothing. Above the ceiling the customer is overcharged. This test types a price just outside each end of the range and checks that both are refused and that neither reaches the invoice.

## Related tickets
RTPL-2788 (Price Adjustments for Cart Items - Quick Sale flow)

## Preconditions
- The rep is signed in at store EZLOGIC on station AK_METROPC.
- Accessory Sale is switched on for the store.
- The till has no customer tablet paired to it.
- The invoice is empty at the start.
- THIS CASE NEEDS SEEDED DATA. The accessory used must have a minimum price set below its list price, otherwise the Price adjustment panel shows the same MIN and MAX and there is no range to fall outside of. The seed asked for is: item 101026 (POPSOCKETS CEILING, list $14.99) given a minimum price of $5.00.

## Test data
- **Accessory to price:** Item number 101026, POPSOCKETS CEILING, list price $14.99  _(verified: UAT3 2026-09-03, confirmed live in the Browse accessories list and the item detail panel)_
- **Allowed range once seeded:** $5.00 MIN, $14.99 MAX  _(verified: Seed requested 2026-09-04 - NOT yet live on UAT3. Confirmed live on UAT3 2026-09-03: the Price adjustment panel exists on the item detail, it shows a Range row with a MIN and a MAX, and it offers the three methods Price, Percent and Amount. What is missing is a minimum price below the list price - every item probed shows MIN equal to MAX, so nothing can be discounted. Re-read the panel's own MIN and MAX when the seed lands and recompute the figures below if the seeded minimum differs.)_
- **Price below the floor:** $4.00  _(verified: Derived from the requested seed - one dollar under the seeded minimum; confirm against the panel's own Range row on the day)_
- **Price above the ceiling:** $20.00  _(verified: Derived from the list price of $14.99, which is the ceiling; confirm against the panel's own Range row on the day)_
- **Expected refusals:** Price below minimum value $5.00. / Price above maximum value $14.99.  _(verified: Wording taken from the application's own message text; the amount in each message is the limit that was breached)_

## Screens (design reference)
- **Item detail with the Price adjustment panel** — screenshot: `screens/quick-sale-02-browse-accessories.png` (attach from the run folder)

## Automation Notes
- Check both halves of each refusal: the message appears AND the add action is blocked. A message that is shown while the item can still be added at the bad price is the defect this case exists to catch.
- Each message names the limit that was breached, so assert the amount in the text as well as the wording - a message naming the wrong limit would send the rep chasing the wrong number.
- There is no manager override in this version, so expect a flat refusal for every user and no approval prompt anywhere in the flow.
- If the seeded accessory does not behave as described when you run this - the Range still shows the same MIN and MAX, or a discount cannot be entered - do not work around it and do not hunt for another item alone: contact the manual QA team to confirm the price seeding has been applied to this store.

steps.expected: The dashboard opens and the header shows STORE ID EZLOGIC, DEALER CODE 30247306, STATION AK_METROPC.

steps.action: On the dashboard, click the Accessory Sale tile
steps.expected: The Accessory Sale screen opens with the heading ACCESSORY SALE and an empty invoice reading Total due $0.00.

steps.action: Click Browse accessories, then click the row for the accessory named in the test data
steps.expected: A panel opens headed Item detail 101026 showing Price $14.99, Tax $1.50 and Final price $16.49.

steps.action: Open the Price adjustment section of that panel
steps.expected: The section opens showing a Range of $5.00 MIN and $14.99 MAX, the three ways of taking money off labelled Price, Percent and Amount, and an Amount box prompting Type here.

steps.action: Choose Price and type a price a dollar below the store's floor
steps.expected: The price is refused. The message Price below minimum value $5.00. is shown against the Amount box, the box is flagged as wrong, and the Add accessories button is blocked so the item cannot be put on the invoice at that price. The panel stays open with the typed value still there so the rep can correct it rather than starting again.

steps.action: Clear the Amount box and type a price above the item's list price
steps.expected: That is refused too, this time with Price above maximum value $14.99. - naming the list price as the ceiling. The Amount box is flagged as wrong and Add accessories stays blocked. A rep cannot charge more than the shelf price.

The refusal clears and the panel returns to the item's ordinary figures - Price $14.99, Discount ($0.00) and Final price $16.49 - with the Add accessories button available again, so the rep can add the item at its normal price.

steps.action: Stop here - close the panel without adding the item
steps.expected: The invoice is still empty at Inventory $0.00 and Total due $0.00. Neither out-of-range price reached the invoice.
